description: Play a sequence of input steps in the running game (actions, keys, mouse), in order and with real timing; hold_frames/wait_frames count physics frames for deterministic timing. Inline set/call/assert/wait_for steps run inside the game between inputs with no time passing, so one call can set up, act and check (a failing step aborts and releases held input). Returns when the whole sequence has finished. To observe something brief (e.g. the top of a jump), pass 'record': the properties are sampled every frame while the steps run, and min/max (with times) are returned. min/max are computed from every recorded frame (up to 3000 frames); only the returned sample list is thinned to 50 entries, so interval_ms is not needed for accuracy. Add a final {wait_ms} step to keep recording after the input ends. Set pause_at_end to leave the game paused when the sequence finishes, so the next call measures the state the input left behind instead of a later one.

pause_at_end.description: Pause the game when the sequence finishes (default false). The response says paused: true.

record.description: Sample node properties during the sequence. Returns summary {min, max, min_at_ms, max_at_ms, first, last} over every recorded frame, samples_total, and an evenly thinned list of at most 50 samples.

args.description: Arguments for 'method' (converted to its declared parameter types).

expect.description: Checks on the summary after the sequence, e.g. {property: 'position:y', stat: 'min', op: '>=', value: 24}; a failure is ASSERTION_FAILED.

interval_ms.description: Minimum time between samples. Default 0 (every frame) — keep it for exact min/max; only raise it for very long recordings.

method.description: Sample a method's return value instead of node properties; 'properties' are then paths inside it (e.g. method 'summary', property 'ball_pos:2'). It runs on every sample, so it should only read state.

mode.description: 'all' (default) keeps every frame; 'changes' keeps a sample only when a value differs from the previous one.

node.description: Node in the running game, relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute.

per.description: 'process' (default) samples every rendered frame; 'physics' samples once per physics frame and adds the frame index — use it for logic in _physics_process.

properties.description: Properties to sample, e.g. ['position:y']; with 'method', paths inside its return value.

items.description: One step: exactly one of action, key, mouse_move, mouse_click, set, call, assert, wait_for — or only wait_ms / wait_frames.

action.description: Input action name from the project's Input Map, e.g. 'move_right'.

assert.description: Inline: check a condition right now; a failure aborts the sequence and releases held input.

message.description: Explains a failure in the test's words; prefixed to the error.

method.description: Check this method's return value instead of a property, e.g. a summary() test hook. Called on every check, so it should only read state.

node.description: Node in the running game, relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute.

op.description: Comparison; changed/increased/decreased compare with the value when waiting starts.

property.description: Property path, e.g. 'position:x', 'items:2', or a script variable. With 'method': a path inside its return value (e.g. 'message').

call.description: Inline: call a game method at this point (like game_call).

hold_frames.description: Hold for this many physics frames instead of hold_ms — deterministic for logic in _physics_process.

hold_ms.description: How long to hold the action/key/button (default 100 ms for actions).

mouse_move.description: Move the mouse to [x, y] (viewport pixels).

press.description: With 'action': press and keep it held (no release).

release.description: With 'action': release a previously pressed action.

set.description: Inline: change values in the game at this point (like game_set), with no time passing.

wait_for.description: Inline: wait for a condition (default timeout 5000 ms).

message.description: Explains a failure in the test's words; prefixed to the error.

method.description: Check this method's return value instead of a property, e.g. a summary() test hook. Called on every check, so it should only read state.

node.description: Node in the running game, relative to the running scene (e.g. 'Player') or absolute.

op.description: Comparison; changed/increased/decreased compare with the value when waiting starts.

property.description: Property path, e.g. 'position:x', 'items:2', or a script variable. With 'method': a path inside its return value (e.g. 'message').

wait_frames.description: Wait this many physics frames instead of wait_ms.

wait_ms.description: Wait after this step (or alone: just wait).
